{{Hatnote|This page is the constructed format, not the [[Jawa]] card.}}
'''Jawa Format''' is a Players Committee constructed format. Its current definition, banned list and version notes are published on the Players Committee site.<ref name="pc-jawa">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/jawa/ Jawa Format], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021120146/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/jawa.html Internet Archive].</ref>

The [[2026 Jawa Cup]] is the published Jawa Format championship on GEMP.

== Deck size ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Default deck size on [[GEMP]]
| 60 cards
|}
The GEMP format definition sets no deck size, so GEMP uses its default of 60 cards.<ref name="gemp-ec48dc19">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/swccgFormats.json swccgFormats.json], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit 16168b26), GitHub.
